Totally Renovated Gunstock & Lake Wini A/C Home
Peaceful Lakefront Cottage | 5 BR | 2 hrs from BOS
listing_info.description:
This classic Maine camp has been enjoyed by our family and a steady group of returning guests over the past years — which is why you won’t see many recent Airbnb reviews :) We’re excited to open it up again and share this special place with new visitors.

If you are looking for a cozy, lake front cottage in the woods, you have found the place. The perfect place to come and connect with nature.

The space
The upper level features a sun-drenched great room overlooking the water — you’ll feel like the lake is right at your doorstep. It has 3 bedrooms and 1 bathroom.

The lower level offers an additional 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, a second living room, and a laundry room — a layout that’s especially appreciated when cousins or extended family are visiting.

You are steps from the water, which makes it the perfect place for families with young kids :)

Other things to note
Note: The two levels are connected via an exterior staircase.

2 Pets Max. Must run by owner.

listing_info.listing_name: Cheerful 4-bedroom cottage on crystal clear lake

listing_info.description: Bring the whole family to this great place with lots of room for fun. Hang out on the deck with a cold drink and watch the sun rise and set, or curl up in front of one of the 2 fireplaces in 2 living rooms. Plenty of room for family and friends. Plenty of room to prepare meals from grilling on the deck to the fully equipped kitchen. And don’t forget to relax and enjoy the beach and bring your sunblock.

listing_info.listing_name: The Lake House at Pine River Pond
listing_info.description:
Welcome to our home on the Penniman Basin of Pine River Pond. Relax at this dog-friendly, spacious waterfront retreat with a private beach and pier, lake access and other amenities. Great for quiet recreation and outdoor entertainment with friends and family; here you can fish, swim at your private sandy beach, kayak, or bring your small boat along to cruise the lake. Boasting nearly 200 feet of water frontage, this is an idyllic one-acre property perched on a peaceful cove.

The space
The spacious interior features an open floor plan with views from almost every room and all the home essentials for your comfortable retreat. A large wall of windows drops from cathedral ceilings and opens to vistas of the peaceful basin teaming with birds and other wildlife. Multiple decks on different levels let you make the most of the tree-lined cove views. The main-floor living area welcomes casual downtime with shows and movies on the TV. The downstairs family room comes equipped for home entertainment with a foosball table and a screening room with a massive sectional and smart TV for family movie nights. The private beach includes dock access and a firepit.

Guest access
Guests have exclusive access to house, yard, and private beach and dock area.
